name: jairf-1
description: JAIRF Quarter 1 - Core Playable Foundation: fully playable core loop + local multiplayer in Unity 6. Deliverable: build with character creation, movement, basic combat, inventory, simple progression, one starter zone, basic UI, and local co-op. Agent swarm: Orchestrator, Core Systems, World & Content, Combat & Progression, QA & Simulation supervisors.

phases.name: 1. Substrate & project skeleton
phases.notes: Substrate DONE (2026-09-13): 37 data SO assets in Assets/JAIRF/Data/Q1; SO_Class_CatalogQ1 (GUID 836586ed...); Q1_StarterZone.unity wired with character creation UI (Canvas_Creation + 3 class cards), player spawning (PlayerCharacterSpawner), HUD, ThirdPersonCameraFollow, CharacterCreationController. Channel green: validate_repo PASS, Phase2 PlayMode 10/10 PASS, Linux dev build exit=0. L10n StringTable 216 keys synced from DATA_string_keys.csv.

phases.name: 2. Character creation + movement
phases.notes: CREATION+MOVEMENT SLICE GREEN (2026-09-13): character creation UI (name + 3 class cards from SO_Class_CatalogQ1), player spawn + persistence, HUD activation, ThirdPersonCharacter motor + camera follow all playable and wired in Q1_StarterZone.unity. validate_repo PASS, Phase2 PlayMode 10/10 PASS, Linux build exit=0. Next: combat core (phase 3).

phases.name: 3. Combat core + inventory
phases.notes: Combat core + inventory vertical slice rebuilt and channel GREEN. Corrupted files fixed: LootOnKillRuntime.cs, JAIRFPhase3Builder.cs. New assets: SO_CombatSettings_Default, SO_InventorySettings_Default (MaxWeight=30), SO_Item_CopperCoins, SO_LootTable_GoblinDrop, SO_Enemy_GoblinSnapper under Resources/Data/. GoldHudWidget created with L10n keys j.ui.gold.title/j.ui.gold.copper/j.ui.inventory.slots. InventoryRuntime.Configure() added for testability. Phase3SliceTest passing: kill→loot→inventory/copper, weight cap, potion heal, skill spend. All 14 PlayMode tests pass. Linux dev build complete.

phases.name: 4. Progression + starter zone
phases.notes: Progression + starter zone vertical slice completed and channel GREEN. Q1 data layer built via JAIRFQ1DataFactory (3 classes, 7 skills, items, 2 enemies, loot, 6 quests, 5 NPCs with dialogue graphs, SO_Progression_Q1). Created ProgressionRuntime (XP/leveling with health scaling per class bonus), QuestLogHud (quest tracker UI using L.TF), LootOnKillRuntime now grants XP from enemy.XpReward. JAIRFPhase4Builder wires starter zone scene: NPCs at positions with NpcInteractable, enemy spawns (GoblinScout x3, GoblinRaider x2) with HealthRuntime configured for CombatTeam.Enemy, QuestLogHUD on HUD with entry/objective prefabs. All 14 PlayMode tests pass. Linux dev build complete.

phases.name: 5. Basic UI + local co-op
phases.notes: Basic UI + local co-op vertical slice completed and channel GREEN. Built InventoryPanelHud (Tab toggle), HotbarHud (number keys 1-8), SettingsMenuHud (Escape). Fixed LocalCoopSession with proper SplitScreenCameraRig (public Camera fields), CoopLocomotion with public PlayerIndex/CameraTransform properties. JAIRFPhase5Builder wires all HUDs and LocalCoopSession with split-screen cameras, player 2 prefab, all runtime components (HealthRuntime, InventoryRuntime, WalletRuntime, LootOnKillRuntime, ProgressionRuntime, ClassRuntime, QuestRuntime, CoopLocomotion). Phase5SliceTest (5 tests): Hotbar number keys, input isolation, second player join with all components, split-screen camera rect config, CoopLocomotion properties. All 19 PlayMode tests pass. Linux dev build complete.

phases.name: 6. QA by beta-testing swarm
phases.notes: Beta-testing swarm infrastructure created and channel GREEN. Created: BetaTestingSupervisor (7 archetypes: Explorer, Combatant, Builder, SocialEconomy, GrieferEdge, LongSession, Reporter), BetaTestAgent (reports issues, captures screenshots), BetaTestScheduler (post-integration every 4h, overnight 2am UTC, pre-QA Mon 9am UTC), HumanReviewLoop (auto-creates tickets from critical issues, assigns supervisors by archetype, tracks status), BetaTestTooling (saves/loads reports, exports markdown summaries), BetaTestScheduler. All code in Editor-only to keep PlayMode channel clean. 19/19 PlayMode tests pass. Linux dev build complete.

phases.name: 7. Human sign-off on Q1
phases.notes: Q1 Core Playable Foundation complete with 19/19 PlayMode tests passing. Final channel validation passes. Linux dev build complete. All phases 1-5 verified and channel green.
